title: 成都

series.next: On the train home, 程远's phone rings. An unknown number. They hand it to you.

setting: A teahouse in 成都's 人民公园, 3 pm. The address in the letter led here.

cheng.name: 程远
cheng.en: the stranger from 红星饭店, shaking

naren.name: 那个人
naren.en: the one 程远 missed by ten minutes

chashi.name: 掺茶师傅
chashi.en: pours tea from a long-spouted kettle

steps.en: Thank you for coming with me.

else.zh: 我还是想去。可是这次，我想你在旁边。
else.en: I still wanted to go. But this time, I wanted you beside me.

steps.narr: 成都. A teahouse in the park: bamboo chairs, mahjong tiles, birdcages in the trees.

steps.en: What tea for the two of you?

say.tip: 花茶 huāchá = flower tea: in 成都, jasmine. 来 = bring (when ordering).

ok.narr: The kettle pours from a metre away. Not a drop spilt.

answers: 师傅，来两杯茉莉花茶，谢谢。
师傅，两杯茉莉花茶，谢谢。

steps.narr: In the corner: someone in a grey coat, a newspaper, a cup gone cold. 程远 stops.

say.en: Encourage 程远: go on, you're right here.
say.tip: 去吧 = go on (吧 makes it a gentle push).

ok.narr: 程远 crosses the room, one bamboo chair at a time. You follow.

answers: 别怕，去吧，我就在这儿等你。
去吧，别怕，我就在这儿等你。
3.gloss: Don't be afraid. Go. I'll be right here.

steps.narr: At the table, 程远 opens their mouth, and nothing comes out.

steps.en: Excuse me. Can I help you?

say.tip: 这位 zhè wèi = this (person), politely.

ok.narr: The newspaper goes down, very slowly.

answers: 您好，这位是程远，红星饭店的。
这位是程远，红星饭店的。
3.gloss: Hello. This is 程远. From 红星饭店.

steps.en: I called your number every year.
Every year: number not in service.
I changed my number ten years ago.

steps.zh: 我每年也打……红星饭店的电话。
steps.en: And every year I called... 红星饭店's number.

steps.narr: They laugh, both of them, at the same moment. 程远 looks at the cold cup, then at you.

steps.zh: 十年……我想找的，原来不是十年前。
steps.en: Ten years... and what I was looking for wasn't ten years ago after all.
So the two of you are...?

say.en: Answer: you're friends, or you're together.

ok.en: Good friends are hard to find.

then.narr: 程远 takes your hand under the table, and doesn't let go.

then.en: Then that's good. That's really good.

answers: 我们是朋友，是程远的朋友。
3.gloss: We're friends. I'm 程远's friend.

alts.gloss: We're together. Nearly a year now.

steps.en: Three cups, then a fourth. 那个人 tells stories about 红星饭店 until the teahouse closes. 🍵

else.en: 那个人 pays for all the tea, and tells you both: whatever you do, be on time. 🍵
